verdict.rationale: Unreal Engine documents several command-line automation paths. The Unreal Automation Tool is described as a generic system for automating testing and building games. Commandlets such as `UnrealEditor.exe <uproject> -run=cook -targetplatform=...` run without manual interaction, a single command can cook, package, deploy and run a project, and Python scripting automates repetitive editor tasks. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a headless/no-render mode (e.g. no-GPU flags), any concrete CI pipeline integration guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless CI use.
